ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels on the distal lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central-basal region and along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous white regions occupying the distal 2/3 of both lobes. A central, low-intensity (black) anchor-shaped region extends from the peduncle base. Irregular, high-frequency vertical dendritic patterns and mottling are observed at the white-black interface. Discrete low-intensity circular clusters (spots) are localized on the white surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal pixel angle estimated at 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary. Left lobe displays three primary peaks with pixel amplitudes of approximately 15-25 units. Right lobe shows more frequent, lower-amplitude serrations isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, tapering to sharp upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, protruding clusters of high-contrast, complex geometric shapes (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Discrete small circular low-intensity clusters are visible on the medial-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-intensity horizontal linear disruption detected on the right lobe's white field. Multiple vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the central dark pigmentation region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization by stalked barnacles at the tips of both lobes, creating significant structural protrusion. Visible linear scarring across the central pigmentation transition.
other_distinctive_markers: The volume and symmetry of the barnacle colonization at the lobe tips are highly distinctive.
